_schema.stage: PRE_ARR | ARR_POST | DOWNLOAD | PRE_DEP | DEP | ALL
_schema.opens: the event from which the module should receive frames
_schema.closes: the event at which the verdict becomes final
_schema.decision: INSTANT — a single detection → Fail immediately | EVENT — state accumulates, verdict at the moment of the event | DEADLINE — Fail if X is not observed by T | LOOKBACK — at moment T the window before T is evaluated | WHOLE — the whole event or coverage is needed
_schema.preventive: whether the alert arrives while it is still possible to intervene
_schema.deps: what it depends on: tracker (aircraft state: arrival/departure), bl_track, pushback_attached (stage-detector event)
_schema.verdict: NOW — streams without code changes | NOW_PX — without changes, but needs frames | PATCH — the same 3-hunk fix as for aircraft-chocks | RETHINK — two-pass, the first pass determines the geometry; semantically causal, the implementation has to change | POST — in essence the question stays in post-processing
_schema.measured: what has already been measured on the production code

modules.name: 3-stop-brake-check
modules.check: 3 stop brake check
modules.closes: BL stopped next to the aircraft (intersection > 0.2)
modules.why: The stop counter is final at the moment the BL has parked next to the aircraft. Not "after the first stop" — one cannot shout earlier, because it may still stop again. Alert at the moment of parking: immediate feedback, not prevention.

modules.name: aircraft-chocks
modules.check: Main gear chocks removed · Nose wheel chock removed · Nose gear chocks applied
modules.why: The second pass knows median_pushback in advance. main_stream.py — 3 hunks, 0 discrepancies on Main gear. The right place for pushback_attached is the stage detector, not the module.
modules.measured: Main gear 0 batch↔stream discrepancies on 8 videos; Nose wheel anchor shift −7…−444 s

modules.name: all-cargo-bin-doors-opened-and-verified
modules.check: All cargo bin doors opened and verified
modules.closes: end of the stage or 480 frames of open doors
modules.why: Pass as soon as the doors have been open for 60 s in a row; Fail if this has not happened by the end of the stage. Causal.

modules.name: beltloader-chocks
modules.check: Belt loader forward chock remained in place
modules.why: chock_registered while the BL is stationary; verdict when the BL is confirmed. Goes as is.
modules.measured: recall 83%, precision 91% on 29 videos with all 12 violations

modules.name: bl_rear_cone
modules.check: Beltloader rear cone positioned after BL is in place
modules.why: cone_registered after the BL has stopped. The same skeleton as beltloader-chocks.

modules.name: chocks-and-cones-available-and-staged-for-arrival
modules.check: Chocks and cones available and staged for arrival
modules.why: Counts frames with cones/chocks in pre-arrival; verdict at T_arr. The module runs from the start of the stream and stops at T_arr — after that it has nothing to do.

modules.name: conditioned-air-removed-10-mins-prior-to-departure-and-properly-stowed
modules.check: Conditioned air removed 10 mins prior to departure
modules.why: Mean over the last minute against the maximum — a window before T_dep. One access to the frame. Becomes preventive only with ETD.

modules.name: cones-are-removed-only-after-all-gse-is-clear-of-aircraft-and-chocked
modules.check: Cones removed only after all GSE is clear and chocked
modules.why: Fail at the moment a cone is removed while vehicles are still next to the aircraft. The second load_metadata in the code is commented out.

modules.name: cones-placed-in-proper-positions-and-timely
modules.check: Cones placed in proper positions and timely
modules.why: "Timely" — a deadline after the aircraft stops. Fail exactly at the moment the limit has passed without cones.

modules.name: crew-present-10-minutes-prior-to-aircraft-arrival
modules.check: Crew present 10 minutes prior to aircraft arrival
modules.why: A 12-min window before T_arr, threshold 80 frames with ≥3 people. Verdict at T_arr. To shout BEFORE arrival an ETA from the schedule is needed, which the contract does not have.

modules.name: fod-walk-completed
modules.check: FOD walk completed
modules.why: ROI coverage by the walk up to stop_frame. Causal at T_arr, but this is a question about a completed procedure — real time adds nothing except a faster report.

modules.name: gse-chocks
modules.check: Motorized GSE parked and properly chocked
modules.opens: GSE stopped next to the aircraft
modules.why: is_chocked after each GSE stops. video_last_frame only trims the timeline — it takes no part in the decision. 1568 lines.

modules.name: hand-signals
modules.check: All GSE guided into aircraft using approved hand signals
modules.closes: GSE pulled up to the door
modules.why: The first pass averages the door position over the event. Semantically the door is stable a few seconds after T_arr — the geometry can be fixed causally. The implementation has to change, the semantics does not.

modules.name: handrails-on-gse-being-used
modules.check: Handrails on GSE being used
modules.why: Touch counter > 20 per worker. Six image accesses per frame — the most expensive after vests.

modules.name: lead-marshaller-and-wing-walkers-in-position
modules.check: Lead marshaller and wing walkers in correct position
modules.why: ≥2 walkers, left and right, in the pre-arrival window. Verdict at T_arr.

modules.name: pin-verification
modules.check: Pushback operator verifies steering bypass pin installation
modules.why: The first pass is a copy of aircraft-chocks: pushback_window, median_pushback, number_of_frames. The same 3-hunk fix. "TODO: review and rework" in the code. In substance duplicates steering-by-pass-pin — to be cross-checked.

modules.name: post-arrival-aircraft-walk-around-inspection-completed-accurately
modules.check: Post-arrival walk around inspection completed accurately
modules.why: Coverage over the whole event. Partial coverage is not a partial answer — the question makes no sense before the end of the walk-around.

modules.name: pre-arrival-safety-huddle
modules.check: Safety huddle conducted at huddle cone
modules.why: Huddle before arrival; verdict at T_arr. Four accesses to the frame, no networks of its own.

modules.name: pre-departure-walk-around-completed
modules.check: Pre-departure walk around completed
modules.why: The same as post-arrival: coverage over the stage.

modules.name: pushback-does-not-start-until-wing-walkers-are-in-place-and-ready
modules.check: Pushback does not start until wing walkers are in place
modules.why: At the moment of start_moving it is checked whether ≥2 walkers are in place. The most critical moment of the turnaround — here the alert carries the most weight.

modules.name: pushback-pathway-confirmed-clear-of-obstacles
modules.check: Pushback pathway confirmed clear of obstacles
modules.why: Any frame with a corridor intersection → Fail. By type ideal for streaming — and yet measured 0 of 4 violations: it is not the logic that is broken but the intersection detection itself.
modules.measured: recall 0% (0/4), 85% "accuracy" = just passes on the clean ones

modules.name: safety-handrails-fully-extended
modules.check: Safety handrails fully extended and used
modules.why: extended_ratio > threshold over the BL's stay (>60 s). Verdict when the BL drove away.

modules.name: safety-vests-secured-to-body
modules.check: Employees wearing safety vests secured to body
modules.why: frame_unzipped → Fail immediately. The reference example of the instant type. But the most expensive: iterates the video directly, vest classifier + pose. The only module without stage anchors — lives the whole event.

modules.name: safety-zone-confirmed-clear
modules.check: Safety zone confirmed clear
modules.why: The first pass approximates the front-wheel trajectory over the 120 s before the stop and builds the zone. At T_arr this trajectory is already in the buffer — the zone can be built causally. The two-pass structure here is an implementation artefact. The real-time value is the highest of all; becomes preventive only with trajectory prediction.

modules.name: seat-belts-used-on-all-gse-equipped-with-seat-belts
modules.check: Seat belts used on all GSE equipped with seat belts
modules.why: seatbelt_used == False → Fail for the person. Instant type. Pixels needed, no networks of its own.

modules.name: steering-by-pass-pin-installed-or-steering-otherwise-bypassed
modules.check: Steering by-pass pin installed, or steering otherwise bypassed
modules.why: The pin must appear within a 240 s window after the stop. Fail at the moment the window has passed. Pixels unconditional (the finger analyser takes the frame).

modules.name: wing-walkers-in-proper-position-and-using-approved-wands
modules.check: Wing walkers in proper position and using approved wands
modules.why: Walker positions relative to depart_frame; wand_counter > 300. Loads wand_detector.pt, but the inference is commented out — the model is dead, remove before porting.
